metrics.readsAfterPacket: Distinct packet-covered files later read directly (cat, nl, head, tail, sed -n ranges, awk NR ranges) with a range overlapping one already returned by a packet, divided by distinct packet-covered files; no range means whole file; reads before the covering packet do not count. Implemented in metrics.mjs. v2: invalid (null) when any shell segment is unclassified, a successful packet has no parseable ranges or the stream has malformed lines.
metrics.toolErrorRate: Superseded in v2 by mcpErrorRate (MCP calls only) and shellErrorRate (command executions only); file changes are in neither.
metrics.missedOrIncorrectDependencies: Impact and code-change tasks only, for every outcome. Code change: covered paths are files actually changed. Impact: paths named in mustChange, deduplicated; named paths absent at base are incorrect; paths outside the set are reported as precision. Never shown to executor or reviewer.
metrics.firstPassAccepted: Not measured in v2 (no first self-check event is captured).
metrics.totalTokens: Reported processed tokens: executor plus reviewer input plus output, cached input included. Sensitivity reported for uncached + output + w x cached, w in {0, 0.1, 1}, frozen before any v2 cell.
metrics.searchesAfterPacket: rg, grep, git grep and find after the first packet; reported separately, outside the threshold.
metrics.unclassifiedSegments: Command segments the classifier does not recognise; reported.
metrics.usageAssumptions: Checked per stream, failing closed: A1 cached <= input; A2 reasoning <= output; A3 exactly one turn.completed whose input and output equal the per-call session log sums; A4 cache_write_input_tokens == 0; exit status 0; no malformed lines.

qualityGate.primary: missedOrIncorrectDependencies on impact and code-change tasks
qualityGate.rule: Per comparator: Context has no fewer accepted outcomes in total, and on no impact or code-change task a higher per-task median dependency total. Lower on at least two such tasks is reported as better, not required.
qualityGate.inconclusive: All counted medians zero in both arms; a replacement class after seeing results is a new protocol.
qualityGate.structuredAcceptance: Checker passed (code-change and diagnosis), every changed file inside scope.allowedPaths, and blind reviewer accepted.
qualityGate.v1Rule: Lower on at least two tasks and higher on none, with no Context outcome rejected.

costGate.statistic: Sum over tasks of per-task median reported processed tokens; exactly the planned repetitions per task and arm
costGate.rule: Per comparator: ratio at most 0.80 and the upper end of its 90% task-bootstrap interval below 1.0.
costGate.bootstrap: Tasks resampled with replacement, 10,000 draws, seed 20261105, percentile interval.
costGate.reportedOnly: Geometric mean of per-task ratios with its interval; token components; sensitivity weights; reviewer seconds; executor wall time and local preparation.
costGate.incomplete: Any usage check failure marks a cell incomplete, never zero; an incomplete cell in a compared arm fails the gate.
costGate.money: ChatGPT plan allowance; neither plan headroom nor cash is measured or claimed.
costGate.excluded: Indexing, CPU, storage and tool development.
costGate.v1Rule: Context at least 20% below each comparator (point estimate), and sum of per-task median reviewerSeconds no higher.
